§cA SPENT BUNDLE IS MOSTLY STILL URANIUM.§r
PUREX is the good way to reprocess it. The §9eight old Centrifuge recipes are still here§r - they were cut during this release and put back before it shipped, unchanged to the last chance roll - so a standing centrifuge array keeps running and your spent fuel is never stranded. The Canyon is what you build to get §6far more§r back out of the same bundle.

§5R-00 THE CRUDE ROUTE§r §8- plain Centrifuge, EV to LuV, unchanged since 0.23.0§r
  §21x Depleted Fuel Assembly  ->  Uranium + Plutonium + Lead dust§r §8(+ Platinum foil, or Thorium / Naquadah on the bonded grades), 60 s§r
  §21x Depleted Fuel Rod  ->  a third of that§r §8, 20 s§r
  §8No programmed circuit, deliberately: adding one would have invalidated every AE2 pattern already pointed at these.§r
§cWhat it does NOT give you:§r no ceramic UO2 (so the metal has to climb back from F-09), no cladding hulls for R-04, and §9no Nuclear Waste Water§r. That is the whole argument for the Canyon.

§5R-01 THE COOLING POND§r §8- Decay Warehouse§r
Depleted rods and assemblies go in and come out as their §9cooled§r form, on a real half-life. Four grades, rods and assemblies, eight recipes.

§5R-02 / R-03 THE PUREX CANYON§r §8- new multiblock, MTE 28111, IV§r
  §9circuit 1§r §2cooled fuel + Nitric Acid  ->  Dissolver Liquor + Cladding Hulls + that grade's own return§r
  §9circuit 3§r §26,000 L Dissolver Liquor + 2,000 L TBP  ->  4x Ceramic UO2 + 1x PuO2 + Lead + 2,000 L Nuclear Waste Water§r
The uranium oxide goes §9straight back into F-13§r. The plutonium dioxide is the §6only§r source of the MOX blend.

§5R-02h THE UNCOOLED RUSH§r §8- PUREX Canyon, circuit 2§r
  §2depleted fuel STRAIGHT from the reactor + 1.5x Nitric Acid  ->  4x Ceramic UO2 + Lead + Hulls + 2,000 L Nuclear Waste Water§r
  §cNo plutonium.§r §8Skipping the pond costs you the element that needed the wait - which is exactly the trade a real reprocessor makes.§r

[note]§6This is your migration path.§r If you already have a pile of depleted fuel and no Decay Warehouse, the Canyon ALONE clears it on circuit 2. You only need the pond if you want plutonium, which means only if you want MOX.[/note]

§5R-04 HULL RECOVERY§r §8- LCR, EV§r
  §24x Cladding Hull + 1,000 L Hydrofluoric Acid  ->  1x Zircaloy-4 Ingot + 1x Zirconium Dust§r
  §8Zircaloy is expensive and the hulls are most of what a bundle weighs.§r

[note]§6Nuclear Waste Water now has a SECOND producer, and a controllable one.§r The reactor itself has always made it: while the silo is generating it puts out §9one litre per live pillar per tick§r through its own Output Hatch - about §8201 L/t on a full tier-5 plant§r - which is a flood you cannot throttle and can only get while the plant is running. R-02h and R-03 give you §22,000 L a batch§r on demand instead, out of the fuel you already burned. Both feed the same Distillation Tower recipe this mod has shipped since day one: §28,000 L -> small Tantalum Dust + 7,200 L Distilled Water§r.[/note]

[note]That distilled water is not a rounding error: it is §9the bottom rung of the fuel ladder§r. A closed reprocessing loop pays part of its own F-12 water bill.[/note]
